decisions.reason: The scaled title base is 22 pt and is applied to the title system font. Declaration/application source evidence only; no computed runtime style or geometry conclusion.
The scaled row-title base is 16 pt and is applied to each choice title system font. Declaration/application source evidence only; no computed runtime style or geometry conclusion.
The scaled body base is 15 pt and is applied to acknowledgment, status and notes body. Declaration/application source evidence only; no computed runtime style or geometry conclusion.
The scaled metadata base is 13 pt and is applied by metadata() and to choice detail. Declaration/application source evidence only; no computed runtime style or geometry conclusion.
Title and row title apply native Font.Weight.semibold, the semantic 600 weight. Declaration/application source evidence only; no computed runtime style or geometry conclusion.
Acknowledgment, status and metadata apply native Font.Weight.regular, the semantic 400 weight. Declaration/application source evidence only; no computed runtime style or geometry conclusion.
The 20-pt card-padding constant is applied to the outer VStack. Declaration/application source evidence only; no computed runtime style or geometry conclusion.
The 16-pt row-padding constant is applied to choice contents and primary horizontal padding. Declaration/application source evidence only; no computed runtime style or geometry conclusion.
The 12-pt section gap drives the main VStack spacing and primary vertical padding. Declaration/application source evidence only; no computed runtime style or geometry conclusion.
The 8-pt text gap is applied to header and choice text/row spacing. Declaration/application source evidence only; no computed runtime style or geometry conclusion.
The 20-pt card radius is used by the surface RoundedRectangle. Declaration/application source evidence only; no computed runtime style or geometry conclusion.
The 12-pt control radius is applied to primary and choice fill, border and content shapes. Declaration/application source evidence only; no computed runtime style or geometry conclusion.
The 1-pt border width is applied to strokeBorder with accent when selected and clear when unselected. Declaration/application source evidence only; no computed runtime style or geometry conclusion.
The 80-pt row minimum is applied as minHeight while intrinsic height can grow. Declaration/application source evidence only; no computed runtime style or geometry conclusion.

The 48-pt primary minimum is applied as minHeight to the growing primary label. This source declaration match cannot override the separate strict AX-height failure. Declaration/application source evidence only; no computed runtime style or geometry conclusion.
The 48-pt disclosure minimum is applied to the notes Button label frame. Declaration/application source evidence only; no computed runtime style or geometry conclusion.

The title passes the declared 22.sp size to CollectionText, which applies TextStyle.fontSize with system SansSerif. Declaration/application source evidence only; no computed runtime style or geometry conclusion.
The choice title passes the declared 16.sp size to CollectionText and its TextStyle.fontSize. Declaration/application source evidence only; no computed runtime style or geometry conclusion.
The declared 15.sp body size is applied through CollectionText to acknowledgment, status and notes. Declaration/application source evidence only; no computed runtime style or geometry conclusion.
The declared 13.sp metadata size is applied through CollectionText to summary/window and choice detail. Declaration/application source evidence only; no computed runtime style or geometry conclusion.
Title and row title pass FontWeight.SemiBold (semantic 600), applied as TextStyle.fontWeight. Declaration/application source evidence only; no computed runtime style or geometry conclusion.

Metadata, acknowledgment and status pass FontWeight.Normal (semantic 400), applied as TextStyle.fontWeight. Declaration/application source evidence only; no computed runtime style or geometry conclusion.
The 20.dp card-padding constant is applied to the outer Column. Declaration/application source evidence only; no computed runtime style or geometry conclusion.
The 16.dp row-padding constant is applied to choice contentPadding and primary horizontal padding. Declaration/application source evidence only; no computed runtime style or geometry conclusion.
The 12.dp section gap drives the Column arrangement and primary vertical contentPadding. Declaration/application source evidence only; no computed runtime style or geometry conclusion.
The 8.dp text gap is applied to header and choice Row/Column arrangements. Declaration/application source evidence only; no computed runtime style or geometry conclusion.
The 20.dp card radius is applied to the outer surface RoundedCornerShape. Declaration/application source evidence only; no computed runtime style or geometry conclusion.
The 12.dp control radius is applied to notes, primary and choice button shapes. Declaration/application source evidence only; no computed runtime style or geometry conclusion.
The 1.dp selected border width is applied as BorderStroke only to selected choices. Declaration/application source evidence only; no computed runtime style or geometry conclusion.
The 80.dp row minimum is applied with heightIn while retaining intrinsic growth. Declaration/application source evidence only; no computed runtime style or geometry conclusion.
The 48.dp primary minimum is applied with heightIn to the Button. Declaration/application source evidence only; no computed runtime style or geometry conclusion.
The 48.dp disclosure minimum is applied with heightIn to the TextButton. Declaration/application source evidence only; no computed runtime style or geometry conclusion.

Both notes Button handlers invert the current expanded state, store it once and emit one event with current data.requestID and the closed branch. Notes body is conditional on that state. Closing notes is not dispatched by this route; this source-only review does not establish a native callback interval or resulting closed-state rendering.

Self choice calls choose with personal/Self; guards accept a different unsent selection, store self with acknowledgment false and emit one current-request collector:self event. Acknowledgment is delegate-only and validity allows self. Delegate-to-self activation is unexecuted; initial/reset self facts do not prove the callback branch.

The setter accepts a changed Boolean only for an unsent available delegate, stores false and emits one current-request ack:false event. Validity then disables delegate confirmation. True-to-false activation and its callback interval are unexecuted; this is source review only.

Validity permits self; guarded submit records the selected self event value, sets submitted and emits once with current requestID. Source then shows sent status/title and disables choices, acknowledgment and primary. Self submission is unexecuted; this is not native activation or resulting-state rendering evidence.

Both choose handlers return before state mutation and emission when the requested collector is already selected. Same-choice activation is not dispatched; no runtime empty callback interval is inferred.

Native disabled properties are backed by handler guards: choice refuses submitted/current/unavailable delegate; acknowledgment refuses submitted/nondelegate/unavailable/unchanged values; submit refuses submitted or invalid state. Disabled controls are not activated by the route. This source-only guard review cannot assert runtime no-callback behavior.

The sealed source exposes all public data fields/initializer and public View init(data:onEvent:), declares iOS14 availability, and uses ScaledMetric, SwitchToggleStyle(tint:) and the iOS14 onChange form without a later-OS fallback. This is source API evidence; separate minimum-target module/caller compiler checking remains a distinct acceptance component and does not establish iOS14 runtime rendering.
